answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 48751 Country: India Title: We got proposal for my sister. The boy's father is manager in bank. As bank service is haram, so can we marry my sister to that boy, as he is grown up on his father money? They do have another business also but still his father is working in bank. Question: We got proposal for my sister. The boy's father is manager in bank. As bank service is haram, so can we marry my sister to that boy, as he is grown up on his father money? They do have another business also but still his father is working in bank. Please suggest. Answer ID: 48751 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1510/1510/M=01/1434) If the boy is not involved in interest work and his business is lawful and halal then you may accept this proposal. But if you do istikharah then it shall be better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
